pages.text: WELCOME TO THE ANONYMOUS;CODE PATCHING GUIDE
You will be guided through the developer project included with the patch.

pages.speaker: ポロン
pages.text: Yo, Anon. If you're seeing this, your custom scenario compiled and loaded.

pages.speaker: ポロン
pages.text: Heh. Not bad, right?

pages.speaker: ウインド
pages.text: WOOOO! THEY MADE IT IN! Takaoka, our newest anon's alive! That's sick!

pages.speaker: クロス
pages.text: You're celebrating a little early.

pages.speaker: クロス
pages.text: Anon, open the release's SOURCE folder. Read DEVELOPER-GUIDE.md, then open project.json.

pages.speaker: モモ
pages.text: Umm...please don't let them overwhelm you.

pages.speaker: モモ
pages.text: Keeping the guide open while you work should make the rest much easier to follow.

pages.speaker: ポロン
pages.text: C'mon, we're not that bad.

pages.speaker: ポロン
pages.text: Anyway, project.json is where you set up your generated scenes—what they show,

pages.speaker: ポロン
pages.text: what they say, and where they go.

pages.speaker: クロス
pages.text: More precisely: generated scenes, presentation data, next edges, and story injections.

pages.speaker: モモ
pages.text: Please use the engine's Japanese speaker keys exactly as they appear.

pages.speaker: モモ
pages.text: For us, that's ポロン, モモ, クロス, and ウインド.

pages.speaker: ポロン
pages.text: Yeah, copy 'em. Don't make any lookalikes, Anon.

pages.speaker: ポロン
pages.text: And an empty speaker string means narration. No name in the message box.

pages.speaker: モモ
pages.text: speakerGroups controls which configured characters remain visible for each speaker.

pages.speaker: モモ
pages.text: It can also keep a first-person speaker's own sprite hidden.

pages.speaker: ウインド
pages.text: And voiceCharacters lets you reuse matching Japanese voice cues already installed by the game!

pages.speaker: ウインド
pages.text: The patch itself doesn't ship extra audio, though.

pages.speaker: ウインド
pages.text: No free game assets, sorryyy!

pages.speaker: クロス
pages.text: Before you inject anything into the real story, inspect the route first.

pages.speaker: クロス
pages.text: Run tools/Inspect-Scenario.ps1 on the decompiled scenario.

pages.speaker: ポロン
pages.text: It'll give ya the labels, dialogue, speakers, counts, and outgoing edges.

pages.speaker: ポロン
pages.text: Trust me, guessing is how it becomes a shitshow.

pages.speaker: クロス
pages.text: Crude, but correct. Verify the exact target before you edit it.

pages.speaker: モモ
pages.text: If you're only testing a scene, you don't need an injection at all.

pages.speaker: モモ
pages.text: Set launchAlias.sourceScene to its id, run the fan launcher, and choose GAME START.

pages.speaker: ウインド
pages.text: Boom! Straight into your scene! Great for testing and navigating.

pages.speaker: ポロン
pages.text: For the real story, use an edge injection.

pages.speaker: ポロン
pages.text: You replace one verified label-to-label transition with your custom scene.

pages.speaker: クロス
pages.text: source selects the existing storage and label.

pages.speaker: クロス
pages.text: expectedNext proves the original route is still what you inspected.

pages.speaker: クロス
pages.text: If it changed, let the build fail.

pages.speaker: ポロン
pages.text: In other words: don't bulldoze through a safety check just 'cause you're impatient, Anon.

pages.speaker: モモ
pages.text: destination is your branch.

pages.speaker: モモ
pages.text: Then point your generated scene's next edge to the displaced original destination,

pages.speaker: モモ
pages.text: and the base story can resume.

pages.speaker: ウインド
pages.text: Need to cut in at one exact line instead? That's afterLine!

pages.speaker: ウインド
pages.text: One exact speaker, one exact line, then—bam!—your scene branches right after it.

pages.speaker: クロス
pages.text: The match has to be unique and case-exact.

pages.speaker: クロス
pages.text: expectedNext still applies.

pages.speaker: クロス
pages.text: The builder creates a resumeTarget for the continuation.

pages.speaker: モモ
pages.text: Your inserted scene should point next to that resumeTarget.

pages.speaker: モモ
pages.text: That allows the original animation state and downstream edge to continue normally.

pages.speaker: ポロン
pages.text: And use unique ac_ex_ ids and unique resume labels.

pages.speaker: ポロン
pages.text: Don't go stepping on ids unless you're deliberately making an override.

pages.speaker: クロス
pages.text: The installer also checks for the exact archive hashes it targets.

pages.speaker: クロス
pages.text: Uninstall restores the backup.

pages.speaker: ウインド
pages.text: You've got startup, edge-injection, and after-line examples right beside the guide!

pages.speaker: ウインド
pages.text: Copy one, change one thing, test it, repeat.

pages.speaker: ウインド
pages.text: Future-you will be sooo grateful!

pages.speaker: モモ
pages.text: I think that's everything important.

pages.speaker: モモ
pages.text: If something doesn't work, please check the guide and the inspector output

pages.speaker: モモ
pages.text: before changing several things at once.

pages.speaker: ポロン
pages.text: Yeah. One problem at a time.

pages.speaker: ポロン
pages.text: You've got this, Anon.

pages.speaker: ウインド
pages.text: WOOO! LOOK AT TAKAOKA GIVING RESPONSIBLE ADVICE!

pages.speaker: ウインド
pages.text: Somebody save this moment!

pages.speaker: クロス
pages.text: Too late. He'll deny it happened.

pages.speaker: ポロン
pages.text: Shut up! We're done here!

pages.speaker: ポロン
pages.text: Nakano Symphonies did its job.

pages.speaker: ポロン
pages.text: Read the full guide if you need the details, Anon.

pages.speaker: ポロン
pages.text: Aight—back to the title screen!
